items.title: Retarget C# management generation
items.summary: Changes the C# management emitter configuration from API version 2026-02-01 to 2026-05-01-preview without changing TypeSpec service declarations.

inferenceResults.rationale: Changing one C# emitter api-version selection does not itself change the REST contract and supplies no language-neutral SDK contract evidence.

items.title: Customize C# maintenance-window names
items.summary: Adds C#-specific client names for the maintenance-window operation with content and its request model.

inferenceResults.rationale: The @@clientName changes are explicitly C#-specific and therefore do not establish a language-neutral generated SDK breaking change.
